title: Violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='rotate(-25 50 50)'>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='30' fill='#8B4513'/>
    <rect x='47.5' y='14' width='2' height='30' fill='#C8762E'/>
    <!-- scroll -->
    <path d='M50 14 C50 7 58 7 58 12 C58 16 53 16 53 13' fill='none' stroke='#C8762E' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- pegbox pegs -->
    <rect x='42' y='20' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5A2D0C'/>
    <rect x='48' y='26' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5A2D0C'/>
    <!-- strings -->
    <line x1='49' y1='30' x2='49' y2='78' stroke='#F2E6C9' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='30' x2='51' y2='78' stroke='#F2E6C9' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- upper bout -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#C8762E'/>
    <!-- lower bout -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#C8762E'/>
    <!-- waist -->
    <rect x='40' y='56' width='20' height='6' fill='#C8762E'/>
    <!-- edge highlight -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#F2C079' stroke-width='1.4'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='17' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#F2C079' stroke-width='1.4'/>
    <!-- f-holes -->
    <path d='M44 48 C42 52 44 56 43 60' fill='none' stroke='#5A2D0C' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M56 48 C58 52 56 56 57 60' fill='none' stroke='#5A2D0C' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <rect x='45' y='61' width='10' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#EBCB8B'/>
    <!-- tailpiece -->
    <path d='M47 66 L53 66 L51 76 L49 76 Z' fill='#5A2D0C'/>
    <!-- chin rest -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='2.5' fill='#3B1F08'/>
  </g>
</svg>
